title: Welcome Party
description:
Please join us as we kick off our wedding celebrations — an elegant evening of cocktails, music, and our favourite people to kick off our wedding week!
Keep it effortlessly polished—semi-formal attire like breezy dresses, dress shirts & pants, and linen looks are perfect.

faqs.question: What can I expect at the welcome party?
faqs.answer: Join us to kick things off with a laid-back welcome party to relax, mingle, and ease into the celebrations ahead.

faqs.question: Will food and drinks be provided?
faqs.answer: Yes absolutely! Join us for an evening of great food and mingling, with an open bar exclusively arranged for us, all evening long.

title: Haldi & Choora
description:
Please join us as we celebrate this joyful pre-wedding tradition, filled with blessings, colour, and love.
Guests are encouraged to wear soft pastel hues as we celebrate our Haldi in a vibrant and joyful setting.
dress_code: Semi-Formal Indian or English Attire (Pastel Hues)

faqs.question: What is the Haldi ceremony?
faqs.answer: The Haldi is a joyful pre-wedding celebration where turmeric paste is applied to the bride and groom by family and friends. It symbolizes blessings, good luck, and prosperity for the wedding ahead — and expect lots of laughter, music, and a little bit of mess!

faqs.question: What is the Choora ceremony?
faqs.answer: The Choora Ceremony is a meaningful wedding tradition where the bride’s bridal bangles (choora) are blessed and gifted by her family. It symbolizes love, happiness, and the beginning of a new chapter as the bride prepares for marriage.

faqs.question: Can all guests join the Haldi & Choora Ceremony?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — we’d love for everyone to join in the fun and celebrations and experience all the emotions that come with it too!

faqs.question: Do I have to wear Indian Attire?
faqs.answer: Completely optional! We just urge you to join us in Pastel tones to match the theme, in the attire of your choice!

title: Sangeet & jaggo
description:
Join us for an evening of music and dance — a joyful night filled with energy, tradition, and togetherness.
Guests are encouraged to wear colorful, festive, and vibrant outfits as we dance the night away.
dress_code: Colourful Traditional Indian Attire (Any Colour Attire)

faqs.question: What is the Sangeet & Jaggo?
faqs.answer: The Sangeet & Jaggo is a lively pre-wedding celebration filled with music, dancing, and lots of energy! Family and friends come together to celebrate the upcoming wedding with performances, traditional Punjabi songs, and the Jaggo procession — a fun tradition meant to spread joy and announce the wedding festivities.

faqs.question: Can I do a special performance for Abhi & Alisha?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Abhi & Alisha would be thrilled to have you perform for us at the Sangeet; or even better, join us in some performances! Please let us know if you are interested and we will gladly add you into the itinerary for the night!

faqs.question: Will food and drinks be provided?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Expect great Indian food, endless drinks, and enough fuel to keep you on the dance floor all night.

title: Anand Karaj (Sikh Wedding Ceremony)
description: We invite you to witness our Sikh wedding ceremony rooted in Sikh tradition, faith, love and unity. Lunch will follow.

faqs.question: What is the Anand Karaj?
faqs.answer: The Anand Karaj is the Sikh wedding ceremony, a sacred and spiritual union. During the ceremony, the couple circles the Guru Granth Sahib four times, symbolizing their journey together in love, commitment, and faith.

faqs.question: Do I need to cover my head?
faqs.answer: To honour Gurdwara etiquette, all guests are kindly asked to cover their heads during the ceremony. Head coverings will be available for those who require them.

faqs.question: Will food be served after the ceremony?
faqs.answer: Yes! Lunch will be provided following the Anand Karaj. Please enjoy this intermission before we follow with our Hindu Ceremony.

faqs.question: Are guests allowed to drink alcohol during the ceremonies?
faqs.answer: To honor the sacred nature of the Anand Karaj, we kindly ask that guests refrain from consuming alcohol before and during the ceremony. We appreciate your understanding and support in helping us maintain a respectful and meaningful atmosphere for these special moments.

title: Hindu Wedding Ceremony
description: We invite you to witness our Hindu wedding ceremony, a sacred celebration of love, Hindu tradition, and lifelong commitment.

faqs.question: What is the Hindu Wedding Ceremony?
faqs.answer: The Hindu wedding ceremony is a beautiful and symbolic celebration filled with meaningful rituals, prayers, and traditions that represent the union of two families and the beginning of married life. Guests can expect a vibrant ceremony centered around love, blessings, and cultural traditions.

faqs.question: Why are there two ceremonies?
faqs.answer: Abhi & Alisha both believe in embracing and honouring both of their religious traditions with two meaningful ceremonies. We urge you all to join us for both!

faqs.question: Do I need to change outfits between the ceremonies?
faqs.answer: Not mandatory at all! - Please feel free to wear the same outfit during both the ceremonies! If you do wish to change, please feel free to during the lunch intermission but be sure to join us back before the Hindu Ceremony gets started!

faqs.question: Do I need to cover my head for the Hindu ceremony?
faqs.answer: Guests are not required to cover their heads during the Hindu ceremony.

faqs.question: Are guests allowed to drink alcohol during the ceremonies?
faqs.answer: To honor the sacred nature of the Hindu ceremony, we kindly ask that guests refrain from consuming alcohol before and during the ceremony. We appreciate your understanding and support in helping us maintain a respectful and meaningful atmosphere for these special moments.

title: Reception
description:
Join us for our reception as we celebrate our marriage with an evening of dinner, dancing, and unforgettable memories.
Dress to impress. Guests are encouraged to dress in formal evening attire.
dress_code: Formal Indian or English Attire (Any Colour Attire)

faqs.question: What can I expect at the reception?
faqs.answer: An evening of great music, food, heartfelt speeches, and non-stop dancing — expect a lively celebration filled with love, laughter, and plenty of unforgettable moments as we close out the festivities together.

faqs.question: Can guests give speeches or perform?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Abhi & Alisha would love to hear you share a few words for them and/or perform! Please reach out to them so we can add you to the itinerary for the night!

title: Thank You For Coming!
description:
Optional rest day to relax and enjoy the resort!

Please feel free to continue your stay to relax and continue celebrating with us. Please be sure to come visit us before you depart!
We will also see you back once we are home!

faqs.question: Do I have to leave the resort now that the wedding festivities are over?
faqs.answer: Nope! Please feel free to continue your stay to relax and continue celebrating with us!
